rules.title: Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate covered tenancies without just cause (at-fault reasons or specified no-fault reasons). No-fault evictions require relocation assistance; evictions for non-payment require the amount owed to exceed Fair Market Rent; eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance for no-fault evictions; rent owed must exceed FMR for non-payment eviction

requires.name: tenancy_duration
requires.text: the tenant either has lived in the same unit for at least six months or that their original lease expired, whichever comes first

requires.name: not_rso
requires.text: covers most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles that are not regulated by the City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)

exempt_if.name: special_housing
exempt_if.text: transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, owner's roommate, cooperatives under certain circumstances, some non-profit facilities for the homeless or short-term treatment centers for substance abuse, and some properties owned by HACLA or the government

coverage.summary: Applies to most Los Angeles residential rentals not covered by the RSO after six months of tenancy or expiry of the original lease.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exceptions include transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some homeless or treatment facilities and some government-owned properties.

rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act of 2019 (AB 1482)
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are limited to 5% plus the regional cost-of-living change, or 10%, whichever is lower, for covered buildings older than 15 years.

requires.text: buildings that are older than 15 years old

exempt_if.text: Units that were constructed within the last 15 years (rolling basis)

exempt_if.name: restricted_affordable
exempt_if.text: Units restricted by a deed, regulatory restrictions, or other recorded document limiting the affordability to low or moderate-income households

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied_two_unit
exempt_if.text: A two-unit property, provided the second unit was occupied by an owner of the property for the entire period of the tenancy

exempt_if.name: sfh_condo_non_corporate_owner_with_notice
exempt_if.text: Single-family homes and condominiums not owned by a real estate trust, corporation, or LLC with at least one corporate member, where the landlord gave written notice of the exemption

exempt_if.name: city_rso
exempt_if.text: Units that are already subject to the City's RSO

coverage.summary: Applies to California rental buildings older than 15 years.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempt are buildings built within 15 years, deed-restricted affordable units, certain dormitories, owner-occupied two-unit properties, qualifying single-family homes and condos with written notice, and units under the City's RSO.

rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases are limited to no more than 5% plus the percentage change in the cost of living for the region in which the property is located, or 10% whichever is lower
